title: Sikorsky Adds Matrix Autonomy to Beta's MV250 Military VTOL
summary: Vermont-based electric aircraft developer Beta Technologies debuted a full-scale example of the autonomous, defense-specific variant of its Alia 250 eVTOL aircraft on Monday at the Farnborough International Airshow.
